Market Correction is one of many "search and find" missions you get from Tian Wen in ARC Raiders, and it can become a bit of a headspinner.


In the Market Correction quest, you're tasked with locating a cache and sabotaging it to finish the job. This guide will lay out all the essential steps to complete this quest and get your deserved rewards.


Table of contents
ARC Raiders Market Correction quest walkthrough
ARC Raiders Market Correction quest rewards


ARC Raiders Market Correction quest walkthrough


The Maket Correction quest will require us to travel to the Outskirts region in Buried City. To be more precise, you'll need to reach the Marano Station, which is located in the western part of the Buried City. I have marked the location to make it easier for you to find the correct place on the map.


Screenshot and Remix by Destructoid


Incidentally, the "cache" in this mission isn't actually a cache like the ones we found in the Marked for Death quest. Instead, it's a pair of dustbins that you have to find and sabotage. The dustbins are located in the northern part of Marano Station. If you're at the marked location, you'll find a bunker-type structure. Go to its back, and you'll find the dustbins. Once you interact with them, wait for a few seconds for the quest to update.


Once the quest updates, interact with the bins one more time to complete the sabotage. This will complete the quest, and you'll get your rewards from Tian Wen.


ARC Raiders Market Correction quest rewards


The Market Correction quest grants you the following rewards.



Silencer II


Extended Light Mag I


Compensator I



It's a neat set of rewards for the amount of work that needs to be done. If you're looking to complete more quests, both Medical Merchandise and Straight Record are excellent options.

8am PST


10am CST


11am EST

Football Manager 26's Advanced Access Beta has allowed us to get an early glimpse of what to expect from this year's version. While the core gameplay remains the same, here are some changes you will find (compared to Football Manager 24).



Completely revamped match engine based on Unity.


New tactics that allow you to create in-possession and out-of-possession variations.


Better Transfer room.

Pizza is a classic gaming snack, and Call of Duty is a classic game, so why not combine the two?


Black Ops 7 and Little Caesars had the same exact idea. And as part of this year's collaboration, gamers can unlock special skins and prizes in CoD with their orders at the delicious Detroit-based pizza chain. It's a win-win situation.


Here's what we know so far about the Black Ops 7 Little Caesars collaboration.


Black Ops 7 Little Caesars codes


Image via Little Caesars


The BO7 collab with Little Caesars works the same way as it did last year for Black Ops 6. From Nov. 3 through the end of 2025, any order of $3 or more through the Little Caesars app or in-person will reward a code for "Dual Double XP, plus a shot to win exclusive in‑game rewards like operator skins, calling cards, emblems, and battle passes."


Like last year, each code redeemed will reward double XP tokens along with the random chance at even more items, like the anticipated pizza-themed operator skin, and even battle pass codes for those who have the most luck.


If you order in person, the code will be found on your receipt along with a QR code. If you order online through the Little Caesars website or app, the code will be emailed to you. You can then sign up and input the code on callofduty.littlecaesars.com to get your rewards.


The fine print on the website says that you can earn up to 40 hours total of double XP, there are 19,653 prizes available throughout the event's duration, and they range in retail value from $4.99 all the way up to $99.99. The promotion is only available in the US, Canada, and Mexico, so keep that in mind before making any big pizza purchases.



Image via Little Caesars






The event has officially begun as of Nov. 3.  If you're looking to stock up on items like the skin above, double XP codes, or other Little Caesars-themed cosmetic items, make sure to grab them before 2026 rolls around and the promotion comes to an end.

ARC Raiders A Reveal in Ruins quest walkthrough


To complete A Reveal in Ruins, you'll have to travel to the Buried City map. To be more specific, you'll need to visit the Pharmacy (or Farmacia if you go by the in-game nomenclature). The Pharmacy building is situated in the eastern part of the map, opposite Piazza Arbusto.


Screenshot and Remix by Destructoid


I have marked the exact location in blue above. You'll see a gigantic gate that you'll need to breach. The breaching takes long, but the actual time will depend on your build. The Bilguun's Hideout location in ARC Raiders is a vital quest area, but finding the place can be really challenging if you don't know where to look.


This location is tied with the What We Left Behind quest in Spaceport. The quest requires you to find rare loot in three spots on the Spaceport map. This guide will help you find the location if you have yet to find it.


Bilguun's Hideout location in ARC Raiders


The first task is to enter Spaceport. Unlocking the map requires a fair amount of time as you proceed through the earlier locations. Once done, you'll want to move to the central part of the map. Bilguun's Hideout is located right next to the Container Storage building. I have marked the spot on the screenshot below for your convenience.


Screenshot and Remix by Destructoid


Bilguun's Hideout is a small container that's attached to the wall that serves as the boundary for Container Storage. When you approach the spot, you'll want to tread carefully. Stick close to the wall to protect yourself from enemy fire. While I haven't found too many ARCs, the location always attracts human players since it's tied to the quest.


There's a ladder that leads you into the container. I didn't find any loot at the location, but the quest item is a bunch of notes. Once you find the notes, the objective will automatically update, and it will automatically bring up the What We Left Behind quest.


Bilguun's Hideout should be the third and last task to complete as part of the quest. Your first objective will be to find a set of notes in the South Swamp Outpost area of Dam Battlegrounds. This will be followed by going to the Parking Garage in Buried City.


Once you loot any two containers in the Parking Garage, you'll be tasked with heading over to Bilguun's Hideout and finding the valuable loot (the notes).

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Warner Bros. Discovery Sports and TNT Sports are the latest sports rightsholders to request a pirate site blocking injunction at the High Court in London. The specific content the companies aim to protect isn't clear but with football, rugby, MotoGP, UFC, boxing and more to choose from, there's no shortage of options. For UK consumers looking for choice, the opposite seems to be true.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Warner Bros. Discovery & TNT Sports Target UK Piracy Blocking Injunction

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Religion has two faces; that's also true when it comes to online piracy, albeit with a twist. A new academic study has found that those who use religion mostly for social benefits are more likely to pirate than those with strongly internalized religious beliefs. It also pinpoints the mental gymnastics pirates have to use to justify their actions.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Some Pirates Use Religion as an Excuse, For Others It’s a Moral Barrier

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A Pennsylvania man, alleged to be the operator of several pirate IPTV services including 'Shrugs' and 'Zing', faces a potential $9 million default judgment. After major Hollywood studios sued him in March, the defendant was personally served but failed to respond or appear in court. The studios also seek a permanent injunction to take over the associated domain names and cut off its hosting services. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: U.S. Pirate IPTV Operator Faces $9 Million in Damages After Ghosting Hollywood Lawsuit

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A huge coalition of rightsholders with collective revenues running to hundreds of billions of euros, is demanding legislative action to tackle live event piracy in the EU. In a letter to the European Commission, major rightsholders and broadcasters demand three legislative measures. They represent new burdens and liabilities for intermediaries, a potential disaster for privacy-first VPN providers, and risk undermining privacy and security for everyone in EU member states.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IPTV Anti-Piracy Demands Are Bad For ISPs, Spell Disaster for User Privacy & Security

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Nintendo has secured a final default judgment against Jesse Keighin, aka 'EveryGameGuru'. The gaming giant sued Keighin in 2024 after he streamed pirated copies of pre-release games. In correspondence with Nintendo's legal team, Keighin was initially defiant, but failed to defend the case against him. A Colorado federal court has now ordered the streamer to pay $17,500 in damages but refused to issue an injunction against unnamed "third parties" or order the "destruction" of circumvention devices.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Nintendo Wins Lawsuit Against Defiant ‘Pirate’ Streamer ‘EveryGameGuru’

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A powerful injunction obtained by members of the MPA, anti-piracy coalition ACE, and Korea-based anti-piracy group COA, has launched its first follow-up attack after targeting 248 domains in September. In this wave, the numbers are significantly smaller, with around a dozen domains listed for blocking and suspension. However, by aggressively targeting VidSrc, a site upon which many other sites have come to rely, the domino effect could've been significant.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Global Piracy Injunction Targets VidSrc Domains, Hydra Regenerates in Russia

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Meta is using a classic BitTorrent defense in its legal battle with adult film producer Strike 3 Holdings. In its motion to dismiss, the tech company argues that IP-address evidence is insufficient to prove who the infringer is. Meta further counters that the "sporadic" downloads on its corporate network began years before its relevant AI research started. Instead of AI training, Meta argues the activity was likely just for "private personal use"
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Meta: Pirated Adult Film Downloads Were For “Personal Use,” Not AI Training

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The Supreme Court battle over a $1 billion piracy judgment against internet provider Cox Communications is one of the decade's pivotal copyright lawsuits. After the ISP received broad support, including from the U.S. Government, a diverse group of amici have now weighed in to support the music labels. This includes the MPA, former members of Congress, the U.S. Copyright Office, as well as the National Center on Sexual Exploitation.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Broad Coalition Backs Record Labels in Supreme Court ISP Piracy Liability Battle

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A lawsuit filed last November by DISH and Sling TV targeted Richard Moy and CLVPN LLC. It was alleged that Moy illegally gained access to the companies' servers and redistributed their TV content to 450,000 users. To mitigate customer concerns that his pirate IPTV service might be unlawful, Moy allegedly claimed law enforcement affiliation. Unable to pay his attorney in August, Moy has just agreed to settle the lawsuit for a "conservative" $44.5 million.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate IPTV Man Settles Lawsuit For $44.5m Yet Couldn’t Pay His Attorney

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every week we take a close look at the most pirated movies on torrent sites. What are pirates downloading? 'The Long Walk' tops the chart, followed by 'The Fantastic Four: First Steps'. 'The Conjuring: Last Rites' completes the top three.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Top 10 Most Pirated Movies of The Week – 10/27/2025

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
History has shown that if the source of pirated content isn't eliminated, one way or another it will simply reappear somewhere else. Targeting consumer-facing streaming sites does cause disruption, but not as much as targeting the supplier of their streams. Or targeting that supplier's supplier and then hitting the supplier above them. Effective in theory, perhaps, but in the world of 'CDN leeching', pirate streams and legal streams share the same supplier.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The Streaming Piracy Crisis Suppressant That Nobody Wants To Discuss

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A proposal calling for the Spanish government to protect innocent websites from pirate site overblocking has been rejected. The proposal before the Congressional Committee on Economy, Trade, and Digital Transformation, recognized that football league LaLiga needs to protect its rights, but said safeguards are necessary after the wrongful blocking of thousands of third-party websites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Proposal to Prevent LaLiga Site-Blocking Hurting Innocent Sites Rejected in Spain

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
European football's governing body, UEFA, has joined global anti-piracy coalition ACE. The move will help the Champions League organizer to more effectively tackle live streaming piracy. While sports piracy is a growing problem, UEFA has also seen a spectacular increase in revenues. This has resulted in costly, fragmented subscriptions for fans, which some see as a primary driver for the very piracy UEFA is trying to defeat.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UEFA Joins Anti-Piracy Coalition ACE to Protect Growing Revenues from Piracy Surge

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
In the modern piracy ecosystem, sites and domains have become disposable, but "brands" often survive. This phenomenon is highlighted by the MPA's latest DMCA subpoena request, which hunts the "ghosts" of already defeated operations. On behalf of ACE, the MPA requests Cloudflare and the .to registry hand over identifying data for 46 domains. The list includes domains linked to notorious "zombie" brands, including FMovies, Aniwave, and 123movies, as well as new "hydra" sites like Nunflix.org.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: MPA Targets ‘Zombie’ Pirate Brands Including Fmovies, Cuevana and Aniwave

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A decision by Canal+ to target public DNS resolvers to reinforce pirate site blocking, ended with a French court ordering Cloudflare and Google to deny access to list of streaming sites. A lawyer who acted for Canal+ says that led to measurable progress, despite Cloudflare reportedly making "independent decisions" on which sites to block or not. In the political arena, the U.S. govt. has ordered diplomats to oppose EU law that obliges intermediaries to cooperate with rightsholders.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Cloudflare ‘Resists’ Piracy Blocks, U.S. Govt. Opposes EU Co-Op Obligations

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Every year, the Office of the United States Trade Representative uses input from copyright holders to update its list of notorious piracy markets. The process aims to help combat copyright infringement, but for the past several years, recurring arguments and rebuttals have contributed to a 'Groundhog Day' loop. Recent submissions also reveal various 'copy-paste' efforts, highlighting a persistent standoff between rightsholders and accused parties like Cloudflare.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Anti-Piracy Groundhog Day: Recycled Arguments Plague USTR’s Notorious Markets Review

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
DISH Network has filed a new $27 million copyright infringement lawsuit, this time identifying the alleged operators of the Lemo and Kemo IPTV services. The complaint, filed in a Florida federal court, targets a Malaysian company, Kemo E Marketing, and two individuals as the "direct infringers." The suit, which aims to shut down the pirate operations, also names a U.S.-based reseller, '1 Dollar IPTV', which is linked to a now-dissolved company in Florida. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: DISH Identifies Lemo/Kemo Pirate IPTV Operators & Sues U.S. Reseller for $27M

Having established itself as a moving and unpredictable target, it's widely accepted that piracy cannot be defeated using a single tool. Italy's toolbox is one of the most comprehensive available, having just added the ability to effectively fine IPTV pirates twice for the same offense. According to Italy's Minister for Sport and Youth, pirates may soon face the prospect of being named and shamed.

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Reports that No-IP's dynamic DNS service had stopped functioning date back more than a week. After blocking the service, Spanish ISPs displayed 'Error 451' and at least one sent requests to 127.0.0.1. For local internet users, artificial internet disruptions like these are now part of everyday life. They arrive unannounced and disappear a few hours later, usually coinciding with football broadcasts sandwiched in the middle. Those who know who's responsible for blocking ddns.net only mention a court order. It doesn't help.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ISP Blocking of No-IP’s Dynamic DNS Enters Week 2

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
A kingdom in turmoil. Twin princesses kidnapped. And it's up to two intrepid heroes, Hodj and Podj, to compete in a gauntlet of minigames in order to rescue the princesses and escort them back to safety. The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Hodj 'n' Podj. This is the other Boffo Game that shared the Bagel engine with The Space Bar.
Special thanks go out to the folks at ZOOM Platform for supporting us in adding this game.
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. And please take some screenshots along the way.
You can challenge the boardgame, run through all the minigames using the Grand Tour, or pick and choose specific minigames to play. Put your skills to the test, with either a one or two player experience, and find out who the true Hodj 'n' Podj champion is.

Halloween is creeping closer… and what better way to celebrate than with a brand new game ready for testing in ScummVM?
We’re thrilled to announce that Trick or Treat, a Halloween-themed 1994 point and click adventure by ACA Soft, is now ready for public testing in the latest ScummVM daily builds!

Please report any issues you encounter to our bug tracker, following our usual testing guidelines. Screenshots, save files, and detailed notes are always appreciated.
So light a pumpkin and get ready to test Trick or Treat this spooky season!
>

articles.description: Vzhledem k tomu, že je to vlastně artfilm, jsem byl velmi potěšen tím, jak to všechno působivě vypadá (a zní). Ale to celkové WTF (prolínání víceúrovňových snů a podobenství) mi po dvou hodinách připadalo už poněkud nudné a postrádal jsem nějaký závěrečný klíč, s jehož pomocí by to do sebe všechno zapadlo. articles.description: První díl sice měl naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj, ale docela působivou retro atmosféru. Pokračování má také naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj (hodně připomínající libovolné pokračování "Noční můry v Elm Street"), ale velmi překvapivě (vzhledem ke stejnému režisérovi) mu chybí většina té působivé atmosféry, některé scény jsou nechtěně vtipné (strašidelné mrtvé děti za sklem) a film je delší, takže se všechno mnohem víc vleče. (Ilča 30 %)

articles.description: "Pocitový" film s dobře fungující atmosférou a výbornými herci, kterému podráží nohy extrémní délka a extrémní pomalost všeho, co se v něm děje. Při třetím pomalém švenkování po stejné černobílé fotografii jsem zažíval téměř psychoteror a po 90 minutách jsem vážně uvažoval, že odejdu ze sálu. Scénář je velmi špatný, ignorující většinu potenciálně zajímavých zápletek a v různých ohledech odporující předchozím filmům, i když na ně výslovně odkazuje.
